name: Evaboot
description: Evaboot is a lead-generation platform for extracting and cleaning LinkedIn Sales Navigator data, enriching professional profiles, finding work emails, and verifying deliverability.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned API token. Agents may read only bounded daily quota, credit balance, and aggregate Sales Navigator connection counts from the fixed quota endpoint. Relay excludes Sales Navigator account IDs, prospect/contact data, extraction, email finding or verification, Search Builder, job history/results, webhooks, raw MCP, bulk work, polling, downloads, and exports.

capabilities.label: Read quota summary
capabilities.description: Read bounded daily quota, available credits, and aggregate Sales Navigator connection status.

approvalRequired.label: Read quota summary
approvalRequired.description: Read bounded account quota, credit, and aggregate Sales Navigator connection status without account identifiers.

blocked.label: Extract LinkedIn data
blocked.description: Sales Navigator searches, lists, profiles, companies, URLs, and single or bulk extraction jobs are outside V1.

blocked.label: Find or verify emails
blocked.description: Email finding, verification, enrichment, contact/prospect data, job results, and professional identity data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Build searches or automate jobs
blocked.description: Search Builder, job creation, retries, schedules, webhook delivery, and other automation are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read private account data
blocked.description: Sales Navigator account IDs, user identity, job history, prospect records, provider traces, and raw responses are never returned.

blocked.label: Call raw or bulk surfaces
blocked.description: Raw REST, MCP, CLI, arbitrary endpoints, bulk inputs, polling, pagination, crawling, downloads, and exports are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The private account quota read requires matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The selected quota read runs without Relay per-action approval while fixed endpoint, audit, redaction, and response bounds remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts one bounded approval-gated quota read and keeps the token encrypted.
Relay mounts one bounded approval-gated quota read and keeps the token encrypted.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Evaboot account, API token, subscription/credits, linked Sales Navigator account, or live acceptance evidence is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task create a dedicated token, link only the intended Sales Navigator account if required, store the token through Relay, then validate quota redaction, approval/denial, token rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial without starting any extraction or enrichment.

evidence.supports: Official OpenAPI 1.1.0 documents the production origin, Bearer authentication, quota read, extraction, email finder/verifier, Search Builder, and job surfaces.
Official reference documents fixed GET /v1/quota/ and its daily_limit, used_today, remaining, credits, and Sales Navigator account ID/status response fields.
Official MCP documentation exposes quota, credit-consuming email finder/verifier, extraction, Search Builder, listing, and job-result tools; Relay does not mount this raw surface.
Official troubleshooting documents token/account linkage, insufficient-credit, and rate-limit behavior.
